name: Tree Pose
description: Standing balance with one foot pressed into the opposite inner thigh.

source.title: Yoga Journal Pose Library
source.note: Stick-figure approximation. Twists and binds can't be fully shown in 2D.

setup: Stand in Mountain Pose and shift your weight onto one foot.
Lift the other foot and place its sole on the inner calf or thigh, not the knee.

keyframes.name: Mountain Pose
keyframes.cue: Stand tall, feet together, arms by your sides.

keyframes.name: Tree Pose
keyframes.cue: Place the right foot on the inner left thigh and reach the arms up.

cues: Press foot and thigh into each other.
